infobox.effect: Provides 9 inventory slots while only taking up 1

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Loui Peeton deluxe wallet is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 9 inventory slots in a 3x3 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. It can only store:
- Currency
- Keycards
- Physical Bitcoin
- Extraction intel (Besides Ariadne symbol key and Interchange underground utility plan)

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Can't Drink Away Skill

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: This item was first introduced as a reward for a promotional event on Twitch in August 2026.
